newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy April electricity demand up 3.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy April electricity demand up 3.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian electricity demand rose 3.5 percent in April year-on-year on a seasonally adjusted basis, Chicco Testa, chairman of state utility Enel, said.
Testa told reporters that if the fact there were more working days in April this year than in April 1996 was excluded, then the rise would be 6.5 percent. He gave no output figures.
He said the April increase was linked above all to an upturn in industrial demand, particularly by the auto manufacturing sector, and a recovery in the iron and steel sector.
